prep.label: What is in the kit
prep.text: The listing includes a ukulele, tuner, songbook and chord chart. Request the kit at the main desk.

prep.label: Before you go
prep.text: Checkout is free. Ask at the desk or call to check if a kit is currently available.

prep.label: What to bring
prep.text: Bring an eligible card. The policy excludes DIY cards. Each kit includes an instrument, tuner and case.

prep.label: Renewal and missing items
prep.text: Two automatic renewals are possible if nobody requests the kit. Lost or stolen kits incur the replacement cost plus $4.

prep.label: What to do
prep.text: Go to Arts West during open hours. The city's program lists strings, keyboards and drums among its instruments.

prep.label: Confirm before traveling
prep.text: The city provides a program phone and email for availability, eligibility and collection questions.

operators.name: Toronto Public Library Musical Instrument Lending Library

prep.label: What to bring
prep.text: Bring a valid Toronto Public Library card and required ID if the card needs opening or renewal. Borrow one instrument at a time.

prep.label: Where to check availability
prep.text: Call Parkdale, Downsview or York Woods directly. Loss or damage can incur a replacement charge.

operators.name: Calgary Public Library at Memorial Park

prep.label: What to bring
prep.text: Your library card needs photo-ID verification. Check out one instrument at a time.

prep.label: Collection deadline
prep.text: After staff notify you that an instrument is ready, you have seven days to collect it at Memorial Park.

prep.label: What to choose
prep.text: Kings Cross and Green Square lend ukuleles. Green Square also lists compact keyboards and MIDI controllers.

prep.label: What to check
prep.text: Library members may borrow one musical item. Loss or damage can incur fees.

prep.label: What the room includes
prep.text: Hiring the room gives access to the baby grand piano, guitars, keyboards and other equipment listed by the city.

prep.label: Before reserving
prep.text: Check current hire fees and available sessions on the room's operator page.
